gui.mm.effect_studio.part.smoke.tip: Grey smoke that rises and spreads.
gui.mm.effect_studio.part.sparks.tip: Quick sparks that shoot up and fall back.
gui.mm.effect_studio.part.steam.tip: White puffs that rise and spread.
gui.mm.effect_studio.click.port: Click a fluid port of the machine (Esc to cancel)
gui.mm.effect_studio.fluid.title: Fluid from the machine
gui.mm.effect_studio.fluid.pick_tip: Click the machine's fluid port in the 3D view. The effect then reads the fluid inside it.
gui.mm.effect_studio.fluid.change_tip: Click to choose another fluid port.
gui.mm.effect_studio.fluid.colour_tip: Use the fluid's colour. Layers that can take a colour (liquids, glows, particles, beams) copy the colour of the fluid in the port.
gui.mm.effect_studio.fluid.look_tip: Use the fluid's look. Liquid layers draw the fluid's own texture, so water looks like water and lava looks like lava. Seeping sides are plain colour, so they take the average colour of that texture.
gui.mm.effect_studio.fluid.preview_tip: Choose which fluid this 3D preview shows. Machine shows what is really in the port right now.
gui.mm.effect_studio.fluid.not_port: That block is not a fluid port.
gui.mm.effect_studio.layer.stream.tip: A thin line of liquid that falls from a spot down to the floor.
gui.mm.effect_studio.layer.drip.tip: Little beads of liquid that swell at a spot and then let go.
gui.mm.effect_studio.layer.drops.tip: The drops that fall from drips and streams. Add this layer so drips and streams can let go of drops.
gui.mm.effect_studio.layer.pool.tip: A puddle that grows on the floor where the liquid lands.
gui.mm.effect_studio.layer.ripple.tip: Rings that spread across a puddle when drops land.
gui.mm.effect_studio.layer.seep.tip: Liquid that crawls down the sides of blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.layer.emitter.tip: Smoke, sparks, steam or anything made of little moving pieces.
gui.mm.effect_studio.layer.beam.tip: A glowing line or arc between two spots.
gui.mm.effect_studio.layer.glow.tip: A soft light on the sides of blocks, or a ball of light at a spot.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.name: Name
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.name.tip: Your own name for this layer. It shows in the list on the left.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.off.tip: Turn this layer on or off without deleting it.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.skip.tip: Spot numbers this layer should ignore, like 1, 2. The first spot is number 0.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.texture.tip: The picture this layer draws. Click it to choose another one.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.color.tip: The colour of this layer. White keeps the texture's own colours. Click a colour or type one like #7a0a0a.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.alpha.tip: 1 is fully solid and 0 is invisible.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.glow.tip: On: this layer stays bright, even in dark places. Off: it gets darker like the blocks around it.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.port_color.tip: Take the colour from the fluid in the machine's fluid port. The effect needs a port to look at.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.port_texture.tip: Draw the fluid's own texture, so water looks like water and lava like lava. Your texture is used while the port is empty. The effect needs a port to look at.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.blend.tip: Light adds up and glows, and works best with a black background texture. Normal is see-through paint.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.from.tip: The spot this begins at. Click to try the spots of this effect.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.to.tip: Where this stops: a height like floor, or a spot. Click to try the choices of this effect.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.beam.to.tip: The spot the beam ends at. Click to try the spots of this effect.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.at.tip: Which spot of the effect this layer uses. Click to try the spots of this effect.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.top.tip: The height where the liquid starts running down the block sides.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.links.tip: Pairs of spot numbers to join, like 0, 1, 1, 2. Leave empty to join each start spot to the matching end spot.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.radius.tip: How wide the stream is, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.gravity.tip: How hard the liquid is pulled down. 9.8 feels normal.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.start_speed.tip: How fast the liquid is moving when it leaves the spot.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.sway.tip: How much the stream sways from side to side.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.bulge.tip: How much the stream swells and shrinks as it falls.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.flare.tip: How much the stream spreads out where it leaves the spot.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.breakup.tip: On: the stream turns into separate drops when it falls far.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.breakup_start.tip: How many blocks the stream falls before it starts to break into drops.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.breakup_length.ti: How many blocks it takes to finish breaking into drops.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.gaps.tip: How often the stream stops for a moment. 0 means never.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.noise.tip: How much the stream gets thicker and thinner over time. 0 is steady.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.trickle.tip: How often a thin trickle shows while the machine is not working.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.texture_speed.tip: How fast the texture slides down the stream. Below 0 it slides up.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.texture_width.tip: How much of the texture wraps around the stream.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.droplets.tip: On: little drops fly off the sides of the stream.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.hide_when_blocked: On: nothing is drawn when a block is in the way.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.needs_block_above: On: only drawn when there is a block above the spot.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.rate.tip: How fast drops form. 1 is normal, 0 is none.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.drip.size.tip: How big the drop is while it hangs and swells, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.drop_size.tip: How big the drops are once they fall, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.drops.max.tip: The most drops that can fall at the same time.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.stretch.tip: How long the drops get while falling fast.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.splash.tip: How much each drop adds to the puddle when it lands.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.pool.size.tip: How wide the puddle gets when it is full, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.base.tip: How wide the puddle is when it is nearly empty, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.fill.tip: How fast the puddle grows when liquid lands.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.drain.tip: How fast the puddle shrinks when nothing lands.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.swirl.tip: How fast the texture swirls in the puddle. 0 lets the effect pick a speed.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.ripple.life.tip: How long each ripple lasts, in seconds.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.ripple.width.tip: How thick each ring is, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.ripple.speed.tip: How fast the rings spread out.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.ripple.max.tip: The most ripples that can show at the same time.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.chance.tip: How many of the block sides bleed. 1 is all of them.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.seep.speed.tip: How fast the liquid crawls down.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.streams.tip: How many lines of liquid run down each bleeding side, from 1 to 4.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.stains.tip: On: sides that are not bleeding get a dark stain.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.drip_patch.tip: On: a wet patch shows where the liquid starts.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.seep.faces.tip: Which sides bleed, like north, east. Empty means all. It is easier to select the spot in the 3D view and click the block sides there.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.seep.color.tip: The colour of the liquid. Click a colour or type one like #7dff2a. A colour set here wins over the texture.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.seep.texture.tip: Seeping sides are drawn in plain colour. This takes the average colour of the texture you choose, so choose the same texture as your streams and drips to make them match.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.seep.port_texture: Seeping sides are plain colour, so this takes the average colour of the fluid's texture, the same match the streams and drips get. The effect needs a port to look at.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.palette.tip: Seven colours from dark to light, like #300000, #500000. Empty uses blood red.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.rate.tip: How many particles appear each second.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.max.tip: The most particles that can be alive at the same time.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.life.0.ti: The shortest time a particle lasts, in seconds.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.life.1.ti: The longest time a particle lasts, in seconds.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.color.0.t: The colour of a particle when it appears.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.color.1.t: The colour of a particle just before it disappears.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.size.0.ti: How big a particle is when it appears, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.size.1.ti: How big a particle is just before it disappears, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.alpha.0.t: 1 is fully solid and 0 is invisible, when a particle appears.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.alpha.1.t: 1 is fully solid and 0 is invisible, just before a particle disappears.
Push towards east or west, in blocks per second.
Push upwards, in blocks per second. Below 0 pushes down. The orange arrow in the 3D view sets this too.
Push towards south or north, in blocks per second.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.velocity_: How much each particle's sideways push is different.
How much each particle's up and down push is different.
How much each particle's forward push is different.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.box.0.tip: Particles appear anywhere inside this box around the spot, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.box.1.tip: Particles appear anywhere inside this box around the spot, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.box.2.tip: Particles appear anywhere inside this box around the spot, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.gravity.t: Above 0 particles sink. Below 0 they float up like smoke.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.drag.tip: How quickly particles lose speed. 0 means they never slow down.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.spin.0.ti: Turning speed in degrees per second. Below 0 turns the other way.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.emitter.spin.1.ti: Turning speed in degrees per second. Below 0 turns the other way.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.frames.tip: How many pictures are stacked from top to bottom in the texture. 1 means a single picture.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.collide.tip: On: particles stop when they hit a block.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.smooth.tip: On: the texture is smoothed so soft textures look soft. Off: crisp pixels.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.fade_in.tip: How much of its life a particle spends fading in. 0 means it pops in.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.turbulence.tip: How much particles wander around at random.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.size_spread.tip: How different the particle sizes are from each other.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.size_curve.tip: Steady changes size evenly. Fast at first changes it quickly and then slows down.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.beam.width.tip: How wide the beam is, in blocks.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.segments.tip: How many pieces the beam is made of. More is smoother but slower.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.arc.tip: How much the beam bows. 0 is straight.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.jitter.tip: How much the beam wiggles. 0 is steady.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.scroll.tip: How fast the texture runs along the beam. Below 0 it runs backwards.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.texture_length.ti: How many blocks long one copy of the texture is.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.pulse.tip: How much it breathes bigger and smaller. 0 is steady.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.flicker.tip: How much the brightness jumps around. 0 is steady.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.taper.tip: How much the beam gets thinner towards its end. 0 keeps the same width.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.mode.tip: On block sides lights up the sides of blocks. Ball of light puts a soft light at each spot.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.glow.size.tip: For a ball of light, how wide it is in blocks. For block sides, how much of each side is lit.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.glow.faces.tip: Outside sides only skips the sides that touch another glowing block.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.offset.tip: How far the glow floats off the surface, in blocks. Keep it small.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.frame_rate.tip: How many pictures of the animation play each second.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.effect.rise.tip: Seconds the effect takes to fully appear when the machine starts.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.effect.fall.tip: Seconds the effect takes to fade away when the machine stops.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.effect.hold.tip: Seconds the effect keeps running after the machine stops.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.effect.view_dista: How far away, in blocks, you can still see this effect.
gui.mm.effect_studio.f.effect.seed.tip: Changes the random wobble and timing. Reroll in the Look tab picks one for you.
gui.mm.effect_studio.save_failed: Could not save, see the log.
gui.mm.effect_studio.warn.additive: Additive blend on a texture shaped by alpha draws a square. Use a black-background texture or blend translucent.
gui.mm.effect_studio.warn.translucent: Translucent blend on a black-background texture draws a black box. Use blend additive.
gui.mm.effect_studio.controls: Right-drag to look, WASD to move, Space/Shift up and down, scroll to zoom, click an effect to select it
gui.mm.effect_studio.click.point: %s: click where '%s' goes, Ctrl-click to add several (Esc to cancel)
gui.mm.effect_studio.click.area: %s: click a block, every block of that kind gets '%s' (Esc to cancel)
gui.mm.effect_studio.click.underside: %s: click the underside of a block for '%s', Ctrl-click to add several (Esc to cancel)
gui.mm.effect_studio.click.held: %s: Ctrl-click more points for '%s', click the last one or press Enter
gui.mm.effect_studio.click.add: Click to add a point to '%s', Ctrl-click to keep adding (Esc to stop)
gui.mm.effect_studio.click.add_underside: Click the underside of a block to add a point to '%s', Ctrl-click to keep adding (Esc to stop)
gui.mm.effect_studio.seep.any_tip: Let every spot pick its sides at random again
gui.mm.effect_studio.seep.badge_tip: Click to turn this side on or off. Right-click to change how many lines run down it (%s now).
gui.mm.effect_studio.library.add_only: Only works with other layers: select an effect, then click to add it
gui.mm.effect_studio.hide_panels: Hide or show the side panels (Tab)
gui.mm.effect_studio.duplicate_tip: Duplicate this effect with all its spots
gui.mm.effect_studio.remove_tip: Remove this effect from the machine
gui.mm.effect_studio.preset_failed: Could not save that preset name, see the log or pick another name.
gui.mm.effect_studio.drag_hint: Drag points to move them (Alt: height), Ctrl-click or drag a box to select several, right-click for more. Select a drip to pick its bleeding sides
gui.mm.effect_studio.kept_one: A spot keeps at least one point. Remove the effect to delete it entirely.
gui.mm.effect_studio.centre_tip: Move the selected points to the middle of the block face each one sits on. Ctrl-click points or drag a box in the view to select several.
gui.mm.effect_studio.faces_tip: Pick block faces, then put the selected point in the middle of them
gui.mm.effect_studio.click.faces: Click block faces to add or remove them (%s picked). Press Center or Enter to put the point in the middle, Esc to cancel
gui.mm.effect_studio.spot.link: Add an arc from this point: click a point to connect to, or where a new point goes
gui.mm.effect_studio.click.link: Arc from point %s: click a point to connect to, or where a new point goes. Ctrl keeps going (Esc to stop)
gui.mm.effect_studio.spot.add: Add a point: click where it goes. Ctrl-click to add several.
gui.mm.effect_studio.arrow_hint: Drag the orange arrow to point particles (Alt: up/down, longer = faster)
gui.mm.effect_studio.mode.both_tip: Sliders scale the effect while idle and while working
gui.mm.effect_studio.mode.idle_tip: Sliders only change drip and particle amount and glow and beam size while idle
gui.mm.effect_studio.mode.working_tip: Sliders only change drip and particle amount and glow and beam size while working
gui.mm.effect_studio.reroll_tip: Pick a new random look: bleeding sides, stream paths, drip timing, pulses and flicker
gui.mm.effect_studio.blocks.pick_tip: Choose which blocks glow by clicking them in the view
gui.mm.effect_studio.click.pick: Click blocks to turn the %s glow on or off (Enter or Esc when done)
gui.mm.effect_studio.health.no_anchor: Its anchor is missing. Remove the effect and place it again.
gui.mm.effect_studio.health.no_block_abo: Hidden: no block above this point. Place it on the underside of a block.
gui.mm.effect_studio.health.no_landing: Hidden: a block sits right under this point, so there is nothing to fall through.
gui.mm.effect_studio.health.blocked: Hidden: a block or liquid is between this point and the floor.
gui.mm.effect_studio.health.landing_bloc: Hidden: the landing spot is inside a block or liquid.
gui.mm.effect_studio.health.hidden_now: Invisible in this mode. Switch between Idle and Working to see it.
gui.mm.effect_studio.health.drip_working: Drips almost stop while working. Switch to Idle to see them.
